translation_snapshot.source:
Fire a blast of darkness at an enemy dealing %0.2f damage and destroying any walls in radius 3 around them.
		The damage will increase with your Spellpower.
translation_snapshot.target:
发射暗影能量，对目标造成 %0.2f 伤害并破坏 3 格范围内的墙壁。
		伤害受法术强度加成。

translation_snapshot.source:
Allows to teleport to Kroshkkur.
	You have studied the forbidden secrets there and have been granted a special portal spell to teleport back.
	This spell must be kept secret; it should never be used within view of uninitiated witnesses.
	The spell takes time (40 turns) to activate, and you must be out of sight of any other creature when you cast it and when the teleportation takes effect.
translation_snapshot.target:
允许传送至克诺什库尔。
	你学习了那里的禁忌秘密，因此获得了传送至克诺什库尔的法术。
	该法术必须保持机密；绝不能在未入门的目击者视野内使用。
	该法术需要 40 回合生效。施放时及传送生效时，你都必须处于任何其他生物的视线之外。

translation_snapshot.source:
Your body is used to pain. When you take a hit of 20%% or more of your max life one of your inscriptions is taken off cooldown and infusion saturation is removed.
		This effect has a cooldown of %d turns.
translation_snapshot.target:
你的身体习惯于痛苦。每次你受到最大生命 20%% 或以上的伤害时，你的一个刻印将立刻冷却完毕，并移除纹身饱和效果。
		该效果冷却时间为 %d 回合。

translation_snapshot.source:
Enter a killing frenzy for 3 turns.
		During the frenzy the first time you use a class talent it has no cooldown (but does if used twice).
		This does not work for inscriptions, talents that take no turn to use, passives, or talents with fixed cooldowns.
translation_snapshot.target:
进入杀戮狂热状态 3 回合。
		狂热状态下，每个职业技能首次使用时不进入冷却（同一技能再次使用则会冷却）。
		该效果对刻印、被动技能、瞬间技能以及固定冷却时间技能无效。

translation_snapshot.source: The various racial bonuses a character can have.. when its head is cut off and replaced with a parasite.
translation_snapshot.target: 角色可能拥有的各种种族加成……当它的头被砍掉并换成寄生兽的时候。

translation_snapshot.source: The target is overwhelmed by voices from the void, giving them a 20%% higher chance to spawn hallucinations from Dark Whispers and causing them to take an additional %d%% temporal damage from Dark Whispers and Hideous Visions.
translation_snapshot.target: 目标被虚空之声淹没，让他们从黑暗低语中产生幻觉的几率增加 20%%，并使他们从黑暗低语和惊骇幻象中受到额外 %d%% 时空伤害。

translation_snapshot.source: Inside Forbidden Tome: "Home, Horrific Home" for %d turns.
translation_snapshot.target: 身处禁忌之书《家，可怕的家》中，持续 %d 回合。

translation_snapshot.source: Convinced that arcane users are filth to be destroyed.
translation_snapshot.target: 坚信奥术使用者都是必须消灭的污秽。

translation_snapshot.source: #Target# is bolstered at the sight of the horror!
